name: 98-pink-vue
description: Vue 3 component library port of 98-pink.css — a pink & blue Windows 98 UI revival.
author: Meorion <me@meorion.moe>

scripts.typecheck: bun run build:deps && vue-tsc --noEmit && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.demo.json --noEmit
scripts.build: bun run build:deps && bun run generate && vite build && bun run generate:dist && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:demo: bun run build:deps && bun run generate && vite build --config vite.demo.config.ts
scripts.build:ssr: bun run build:deps && bun run generate && vite build --config vite.ssr.config.ts
scripts.dev: bun run build:deps && bun run generate && vite --config vite.demo.config.ts
scripts.test: bun run build:deps && bun run test:fidelity && bun run test:sfc && bun run test:library && bun run test:dom && bun run test:demo
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test
